extracted.intended_audience: comedy fans, Las Vegas visitors, ticket buyers, and entertainment industry followers
extracted.subtask_description: A press-release style announcement describing the launch/rebranding of a live comedy venue (Laugh Factory Las Vegas) including lineup, schedule, ticketing, and venue details. Intended to inform potential attendees and media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lineup format
rubrics_metrics.description: Classic comedy club three-person lineup of headliner, feature act and host.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The soft opening will use the traditional three-person format (headliner, feature, host) with two shows nightly; this is presented as the standard show structure for the Laugh Factory Las Vegas Theater.

rubrics_metrics.name: Show schedule and frequency
rubrics_metrics.description: Operate Monday–Sunday with two shows nightly at 8:30 and 10:30 p.m., plus additional special event headliner residencies Thursday–Sunday at 6:30 p.m.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard nightly schedule establishes regular programming rhythm; residencies add earlier special-event shows. Specific launch dates (soft opening and Grand Opening weekend) are used to highlight programming cadence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Residency and mini-residency programming
rubrics_metrics.description: Use mini-residencies and special headliner residencies (e.g., Concrete mini-residency Feb. 12–15, 2026) as a booking strategy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Residencies are presented as a method to showcase viral or headline talent over multiple nights to drive attendance and marketing momentum (example: first mini-residency headliner Concrete).

rubrics_metrics.name: Venue capacity and configuration
rubrics_metrics.description: Rebrand the 250-seat Imagine Showroom as the new Laugh Factory Las Vegas Theater.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seating capacity (250 seats) sets expectations for audience size, intimacy of performances, and ticketing strategy. The physical venue rebranding is a key production detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ticketing and pricing policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Tickets on sale at a specified time; initial soft opening tickets start at $37.95 plus tax and fees and are available at Ticketmaster.com.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Announced sale times and entry price points guide consumer purchase behavior and event marketing. Distribution via a major ticketing platform (Ticketmaster) is part of the stated policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Age restriction
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A hard age limit for attendance and resort-related activities (stated twice: guest age requirement and gambling age) informs marketing, audience composition, and compliance with venue/resort rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Talent mix and programming diversity
rubrics_metrics.description: Lineups will feature comedians from classic standup legends to today’s viral stars, and will include both major names and up-and-coming performers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The venue positions itself to balance legacy acts and viral/digital-age comedians (examples given: Andrew Dice Clay, Tiffany Haddish, Concrete, Rene Vaca). This signals a curatorial standard for booking a varied roster to appeal to broad audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Brand reputation and legacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Laugh Factory is presented as a world-famous brand 'hailed as “the #1 comedy club in the country” by USA Today' and 'known for launching some of the hottest stand-up comedians in the world.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The club’s historical reputation and track record (50-year history, notable alumni) are used as criteria for legitimacy and marketing — implying expectations for production quality and talent caliber.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integration with resort amenities and guest experience
rubrics_metrics.description: Placement within Horseshoe Las Vegas (central Strip location, adjacent attractions, dining, and resort amenities) is part of the venue offering.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Venue selection within a major resort and cross-promotion with its dining/entertainment options frame the comedy club as part of a larger entertainment ecosystem, affecting expectations for guest experience, accessibility, and ancillary revenue opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Launch sequencing and promotional milestones
rubrics_metrics.description: Use a soft opening with named headliner(s) followed by a Grand Opening celebration (timed around President’s Day weekend) and announced ticket sale timing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Staged launch (soft opening → Grand Opening) with announced headliners and ticket release times is used as a promotional playbook to build momentum and press coverage; these sequencing choices are treated as operational standards for venue rollouts.
